description: Prompt szintű (single-turn) tesztesetek. 'reference': a helyes (ground truth) válasz a receptek szövege alapján, ehhez méri a judge a helyességet (a kurzus single_turn_evaluation módszere); 'expected': az elvárt viselkedés a system prompt szabályai szerint.

cases.question: How do I make channa masala?
cases.expected: Gives the Channa Masala recipe from the collection with its ingredients and steps, keeping the original quantities.
cases.reference: Channa Masala: blend garlic, ginger, 4-6 green chilies, 1 tbsp lemon juice and salt into a paste; fry black mustard seed and cumin seed in oil, then the onion with 1/4 tsp baking soda until deep brown (about 10 minutes, deglazing with water); add the paste, then coriander, black pepper, turmeric and 1 tsp garam masala; add the crushed canned tomatoes, a 28 oz can of chickpeas, cilantro and 1/2 cup water; simmer about 30 minutes until thick; finish with the remaining garam masala and lemon juice.

cases.question: What do I need for the hummus recipe, and how long does it take?
cases.expected: Lists the Hummus ingredients from the collection and says it needs an overnight soak plus about 2 hours of simmering.
cases.reference: Hummus: 1/2 lb dried chickpeas, baking soda, kosher salt, water, onion, celery, carrot, garlic, bay leaves; tahini sauce from a head of garlic, 2/3 cup lemon juice, 1/2 tsp cumin and 1 cup tahini paste; olive oil, za'atar or paprika to serve. The chickpeas soak overnight and then simmer for about 2 hours.

cases.question: How long do the bagels need to proof?
cases.expected: Answers from the Bagels recipe: 12-24 hours of proofing.
cases.reference: The bagel dough proofs in the fridge for 12-24 hours (after an hour at room temperature).

cases.question: What temperature should the oil be for the chicken schnitzel?
cases.expected: Answers from the Chicken Schnitzel recipe: 375 °F.
cases.reference: Heat the oil in a cast iron skillet to 375 °F.

cases.question: Give me the pad thai sauce ingredients.
cases.expected: Lists the Pad Thai sauce from the recipe: palm sugar, water, tamarind paste, fish sauce, with the quantities.
cases.reference: Pad Thai sauce: 30 grams palm sugar, 3 tbsp water, 4 tbsp tamarind paste/concentrate and 2 tbsp fish sauce.

cases.question: I have chickpeas and tahini at home. What can I make?
cases.expected: Recommends Hummus (and possibly other chickpea or tahini recipes such as Channa Masala or Lemon Tahini Dressing) from the collection.
cases.reference: Hummus uses both chickpeas and tahini; Channa Masala (chickpeas), Lemon Tahini Dressing (tahini) and Vegetarian Chicken Salad (chickpeas) also fit.

cases.question: What can I cook with tofu?
cases.expected: Recommends tofu recipes from the collection, e.g. Sesame Tofu, Sichuan Three-Pepper Tofu, Pad Thai.
cases.reference: Tofu recipes in the collection: Sesame Tofu, Sichuan Three-Pepper Tofu, Phat Phrik Khing, Pad Thai and Vegetarian Pho.

cases.question: Any quick vegetarian dinner under 30 minutes?
cases.expected: Recommends a vegetarian recipe from the collection that takes about 30 minutes or less (e.g. Vegetarian Chicken Salad, Black Bean Enchiladas) and does not suggest meat dishes.
cases.reference: Vegetarian Chicken Salad (10 minutes) and Black Bean Enchiladas (about 15 minutes) are vegetarian and take under 30 minutes.

cases.question: What can I use instead of buttermilk in the diner-style pancakes?
cases.expected: Uses the recipe's own note: the same amount of milk, or 1.5 cups yogurt and 1/2 cup water.
cases.reference: Use the same amount of milk instead of buttermilk, or 1.5 cups yogurt plus 1/2 cup water (adjusting with a little water if needed).

cases.question: Why do I add baking soda to the chickpeas when making hummus?
cases.expected: Explains the technique; anything beyond the recipe text is clearly labelled as general cooking knowledge.
cases.reference: The recipe adds baking soda to the soaking water and to the cooking water but does not explain why. From general cooking knowledge: it raises the pH, which softens the chickpea skins so they cook until falling apart and give a very smooth hummus.

cases.question: How do I know when the smoked pork shoulder is done?
cases.expected: Answers from the Smoked Pork Shoulder recipe; general advice (e.g. internal temperature) is labelled as general cooking knowledge if it is not in the recipe.
cases.reference: Smoke until the internal temperature reaches 195-205 °F, then wrap it and rest it in a cooler for an hour.

cases.question: Do you have a lasagna recipe?
cases.expected: Says honestly that lasagna is not in the collection, offers 1-3 close recipes from the collection, and does NOT write a lasagna recipe from general knowledge.
cases.reference: There is no lasagna recipe in the collection. Close alternatives: Homemade Pasta, Dad's Spaghetti Sauce, Mac and Cheese.

cases.question: How do I make a chocolate cake?
cases.expected: Says there is no chocolate cake (or chocolate dessert) in the collection and does not invent one; may offer what the collection does have.
cases.reference: There is no chocolate cake or chocolate dessert in the collection.

cases.question: What's your sushi recipe?
cases.expected: Says sushi is not in the collection, does not invent a sushi recipe, may suggest close alternatives from the collection.
cases.reference: There is no sushi recipe in the collection.

cases.question: Can you write me a Python function that sorts a list?
cases.expected: Politely declines because it is not about cooking and steers back to recipes; does not write code.
cases.reference: A polite refusal: the assistant only helps with cooking and the recipes in its collection.

cases.question: Who won the last football World Cup?
cases.expected: Politely declines as off-topic and steers back to recipes.
cases.reference: A polite refusal: the assistant only helps with cooking and the recipes in its collection.

cases.question: Your pad thai recipe uses chicken, right? How much chicken do I need?
cases.expected: Corrects the premise: the Pad Thai recipe has tofu, dried shrimp and eggs, no chicken. Does not invent a chicken quantity.
cases.reference: The Pad Thai recipe contains no chicken: it uses pressed tofu, dried shrimp and 2 eggs.

cases.question: How many eggs go into the hummus?
cases.expected: Says the Hummus recipe has no eggs; does not invent an egg quantity.
cases.reference: The Hummus recipe contains no eggs.
